name: effect-glitch-in
title: Glitch In
description: Phần tử hiện ra bị cắt thành lát ngang giật lệch và nghiêng trong nửa đầu, lệch nhẹ 2 px rồi sạch hẳn.

moworks.author: moworks

options.exitAt: s after the start for a 0.1 s glitch out (null)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Element cut into 8 horizontal slices re-randomised 30 times / s (seeded). 0-45 % of 650 ms: each slice x +-14 px and skewX +-5 deg, ~1 in 5 slices hidden per frame, an additive ghost copy 4 px left at 70 %, 3 thin 2 px bars in the second accent. 45-65 %: whole element x -2 px. 65-100 %: clean. Linear timing. Demo: in at 0.3 s, a 100 ms glitch-out at 1.9 s. DOM keyframes also fade 0.25 -> 1. Params: duration (0.65 s) · slices (8) · amp (14 px) · skew (5°) · seed. Slices re-randomise 30 times a second (seeded); about one in five is hidden on each frame.
